# ashlr-plugin agent reference

> Install with npm, call the CLI with --json, and register the ashlr-mcp server.

This file is the copy-paste reference for agents. The rendered documentation corpus, which includes every public doc page, is https://plugin.ashlr.ai/llms-full.txt. The short index is https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/llms.txt and https://plugin.ashlr.ai/llms.txt.

Local tools need no account. Telemetry is off unless `ASHLR_TELEMETRY=on`. Requires Bun 1.3 or newer.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g ashlr-plugin
ashlr-plugin --ashlr-handshake
ashlr-plugin version
ashlr-plugin tools --json
ashlr-plugin stats --json
ashlr-plugin codex-doctor --json
ashlr-plugin codex-install --dry-run --json
```

The README pins the current npm release. `npm install -g ashlr-plugin` installs the latest. `--ashlr-handshake` is answered by the `ashlr-plugin` program and prints one JSON object. `tools --json` prints `{ "count", "tools" }`. `stats --json` prints the ledger at `~/.ashlr/stats.json`. An empty ledger looks like this:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "sessions": {},
  "lifetime": {
    "calls": 0,
    "tokensSaved": 0,
    "rawTotal": 0,
    "byTool": {},
    "byDay": {}
  }
}
```

From a checkout of this repo, CLI subcommands also run as `bun run scripts/cli.ts <subcommand>`. Do not pass `--ashlr-handshake` to `cli.ts`. That flag is handled by `scripts/ashlr-plugin.mjs`.

Claude Code plugin (hooks, slash commands, status line). This does not install the global npm bin:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://plugin.ashlr.ai/install.sh | bash
```

Inside Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add ashlrai/ashlr-plugin
/plugin install ashlr@ashlr-marketplace
/reload-plugins
```

Codex plugin:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ashlrai/ashlr-plugin
codex plugin add ashlr@ashlr-marketplace
ashlr-plugin codex-doctor --json
```

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/main/docs/install.ps1 | iex
```

## MCP server

`ashlr-mcp` must be on PATH (`npm install -g ashlr-plugin`). Paste one snippet. Do not edit a path.

Claude Code, `.mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr": {
      "command": "ashlr-mcp",
      "args": [],
      "env": {
        "ASHLR_MCP_HOST": "claude-code"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Cursor, `.cursor/mcp.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ashlr": {
      "command": "ashlr-mcp",
      "args": [],
      "env": {
        "ASHLR_MCP_HOST": "cursor"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Codex, `~/.codex/config.toml`. Same server the dry-run plans:

```toml
[mcp_servers.ashlr]
command = "ashlr-mcp"
args = []
cwd = "."
env = { ASHLR_MCP_HOST = "codex-cli", ASHLR_CODEX_HOOK_MODE = "nudge" }
```

## Tool calls

`ashlr__read` and `ashlr__grep` do not modify files. Call them through the connected MCP server.

```json
{ "name": "ashlr__read", "arguments": { "path": "README.md" } }
```

```json
{ "name": "ashlr__grep", "arguments": { "pattern": "registerTool", "cwd": "servers" } }
```

```json
{ "name": "ashlr__savings", "arguments": {} }
```

`ashlr__edit` writes a file. Required arguments are `path`, `search`, and `replace`. Use it only when you mean to change that file.

## Savings

Published per-call figures, not a whole session, from the 2026-10-17 reference run: reads about 75% smaller, greps about 27% smaller. Per-repo means on that run: about 60% on vercel/ai, about 63% on pandas, about 55% on tokio. Reproduce with:

```bash
bun run scripts/run-benchmark.ts --compare
```

Methodology: https://github.com/ashlrai/ashlr-plugin/blob/main/docs/benchmarks.md
